# Mike Moll

> Mike Moll makes service business owners and their offers more sellable. He fixes offers, pricing, and sales so they sell for more (the Compression Method), and gets experts booked on podcasts to grow authority.

## Work with Mike
- [How I help](https://www.mikemoll.co/): the two ways in — fix your offer, or get on podcasts.
- [Consulting / 30-30-30](https://www.mikemoll.co/consulting): 90-day program to raise price, close rate, and cut delivery hours.

## Free
- [The Undervalued Expert podcast](https://www.mikemoll.co/podcast): short episodes for experts who undercharge.
- [Free resources](https://www.mikemoll.co/free-resources): trainings on LinkedIn leads, podcast guesting, and Claude.
